type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: Address code review: Add TODO comments to incomplete Lean proofs
Add comprehensive tests for state logic parser
Add state logic framework documentation and implementation

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: indus_inscriptions_are_state_logic
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (insc : Inscription), standard_length insc → (∃ (decl : StateDeclaration), well_formed decl ∧ self_executing decl ∧ (∀ s ∈ insc, ¬has_temporal_marker s))

theorems_only_on_branches.name: position_determines_function
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : StateSign) : s.position = InscriptionPosition.initial → (s.component = StateComponent.authority ∨ s.component = StateComponent.agent)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: standard_length_complete
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (insc : Inscription) : standard_length insc → ∃ (decl : StateDeclaration), well_formed decl

theorems_only_on_branches.name: state_context_independent
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (decl1 decl2 : StateDeclaration) : decl1.object.id = decl2.object.id ∧ decl1.closure.id = decl2.closure.id → (well_formed decl1 ↔ well_formed decl2)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: wellformed_implies_valid
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (decl : StateDeclaration) : well_formed decl → ∃ (state : ModalOp), state = ModalOp.valid

theorems_only_on_branches.name: wellformed_satisfies_modal
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (decl : StateDeclaration) : well_formed decl → satisfies decl (state_modal_formula decl)
